title: [Informações do servidor] Alterações de MAU
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*


MAJOR CHANGES

Changes in the class of a Specialist Pilot
  • Increased passive buff damage from 10% attack to 23% attack
  • Increased the repair discount from passive buff from 20% to 36%
Changes in the damage of MAU Hands

  • Reduced damage from all MAU hands by 10%. Thus, the Cross-MAU became weaker, and for Specialist Pilots, the damage did not change.
  • Red MAU hands 50 level 1GR are now a cheap, slightly enhanced version of 48 level MAU hands

MAU repair price changes

The price of repairing an incompletely destroyed MAU has been increased by 30%. Together with other changes, Cross-MAU have become more expensive to repair, and for pure Pilot Specialists, the cost of repair almost did not change.

Price changes of MAU equipment

Changed the price of Goliath MAU Shoulder
  • 45 Lv 700.000 -> 7.000.000
  • 49 Lv 2.500.000 -> 15.000.000
  • 53 Lv 2.500.000 -> 140.000.000

Changes to Goliath's "Web"
  • Changed the cost of the Web stack to 250,000
  • Changed the number of Webs in the stack to 3 pieces
  • The radius of using the Web has been changed depending on the level of the MAU Shoulder Pad
    • 30 Lv 180 -> 80
    • 45 Lv 225 -> 100
    • 49 Lv 225 -> 150
    • 53 Lv 225 -> 190
    • 60 Lv 225 -> 220
    • 60 Lv 225 -> 230
Other changes
  • Lv 50 2gr. hands Removed from the game;
  • Changed the level of Goliath's Shoulder Pad from level 54 to level 53.
  • Changed the visual of level 65 MAU


MAU GENERATORS

There are 3 generators available for MAU, each of which increases outgoing damage and reduces incoming damage. All generators can be stucked.

Divine PvP MAU Generator – Increases MAU attack and defense by 10%. Available* On NPC Point Item (PvP Reward Merchant) for PvP Points. The time of ownership of the generator is 5 days.

Hunter's MAU Generator – Increases MAU attack and defense by 20%. Available* On sale NPC Dragon knight for Hunting Points. The time of ownership of the generator is 3 days.
*Hunting Points can be obtained in the Hunters' Desert location, which is available from level 55+.

Paragon (Hero's Path) Attack and Defense Generators – Increases the attack and defense of the MAU by 4% for each level of the Paragon Generator (maximum level 5 generator). You can improve Paragon Generators by getting level 66 and dropping it back to level 65.
